exposure: presence or absence of seizures during pregnancy
cohort: 75 pregnant women with a history of epilepsy who delivered at Beijing Tiantan Hospital, China between January 2006 and December 2019
finding: Pregnant women with epilepsy (WWE) were at higher risk of anemia, gestational hypertension, PROM, cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and low newborn weight and Apgar score compared to pregnant women without epilepsy.
mod_finding: This study found that pregnant women with epilepsy (WWE) had a significantly higher incidence of cesarean section compared to pregnant women without epilepsy.
